name: Mason Ulrika Borchard
abstract_title: Ionosphere: Immersive Audiovisual Feedback Amplifies Consciousness-RNG Effects by 12.9-Fold Through Temporal Burst Detection
abstract: Ionosphere is a new research platform designed to accelerate mind-matter interaction experiments by moving beyond traditional Quantum Random Number Generator studies pioneered by the Princeton Engineering Anomalies Research (PEAR) group. notes: Developed algorithms combining machine learning with RNG-driven feedback.
